title: Coldtea.ai: Make your software self-driving | Product Hunt
excerpt: The faster your team ships with AI, the harder it becomes to keep production stable. Not anymore. Coldtea is an agentic IDE where your coding agents build, visual QA agents catch regressions, and AI monitoring watches production, so your team can keep moving at agent speed without breaking anything
